description: Cancel active runs. delegationId selects one (announced in progress before spawn — the only handle if a run wedges at startup; a delegate task's id is its delegationId), threadId all on its thread, neither all. Waits for settlement; if the stop cannot confirm the exit, it still returns and the delegate result warns. Status: cancelled, nothing-active, or not-found (no active run with this ID).
name: cancel
title: Cancel Codex delegation
